title: Brokoli pipeline IR 2.2
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for the pipeline intermediate representation the server accepts at create/update/import (ADR-014 rule 1; issue #109 M1), extended per ADR-032 section 12 step 2 with a node-level 'interface' field and a pipeline-level 'parameters' object -- both additive and optional, both $ref-ing docs/schema/task-interface-v1.json. IR 2.0 and 2.1 documents are valid 2.2 documents that simply carry neither field. This schema does not yet gate acceptance behind a capability: no server-side deploy/validate path reads 'interface' or 'parameters' yet (ADR-032 rollout step 2 is a schema-and-reference-table landing, matching step 1's own scope note), so a server has nothing to falsely claim by accepting this shape -- there is no task-ports-v1 feature advertised yet, deliberately. Transcribed alongside models.Pipeline/models.Node exactly as pipeline-ir-2.1.json is; a change to either without the other is a contract break, enforced by models/ir_schema_contract_test.go.

id.description: Server-assigned identity. Ignored on create (regenerated); immutable on update.

ir_version.description: Empty means a pre-versioned legacy client; accepted with 2.0 semantics.

catchup.description: Opt into per-interval catch-up (ADR-028 phase 2): after downtime, one run per missed schedule interval, oldest first, instead of the default single catch-up run for the most recently missed tick.

params.description: The legacy untyped run-parameter map (ADR-032 section 3: 'the legacy top-level params: map[string]string remains readable during migration'). Distinct from 'parameters' below -- never silently merged with it.

parameters.description: Typed pipeline parameter declarations (ADR-032 section 3). Additive and optional; a server that does not yet interpret this field still accepts and echoes it verbatim like any other forward-compatible field. Not yet validated against run requests -- that is ADR-032 rollout step 4.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks keyed by event name.

sla_deadline.description: HH:MM daily completion deadline. Stored by every edition; monitored only by enterprise deployments.

extensions.description: The one open namespace in an otherwise fail-closed payload (ADR-014 rules 8/9): newer clients park fields this server doesn't understand here; the server persists and echoes them verbatim without interpreting them.

pipeline_id.description: Stable logical slug -- deploy tooling and git-sync match on this.

type.description: Node type string. Deliberately NOT an enum: executors (plugins) may claim types beyond the built-in set. Whether a type is executable on a given server is decided by executable validation at save time, not by this schema.

config.description: Free-form node configuration, interpreted per type. Unknown keys inside config are tolerated (and today, silently ignored) -- narrowing this is #109 M2 territory.

interface.description: The node's ADR-032 task interface (named ports, cardinality, and any task-local parameters), when known. Additive and optional; absent means unknown, never a guess (ADR-032 section 6). Not yet populated by any server code path in this schema revision -- see docs/schema/task-interface-canonicalization.md and issue #439 step 2 for the reference table of which built-in node types have an already-known interface and why several are deliberately excluded.

condition.description: Branch label for edges leaving a condition node. Requires ir_version 2.1 or 2.2; every edge leaving a condition node must carry one under either. Omitted entirely (never null) on ordinary edges.
